verdict.rationale: Algolia's first-party docs show a dedicated custom-ranking feature for adapting relevance beyond text matching. They also document rules to override relevance (for example, repositioning products or running seasonal promotions), Merchandising Studio for pinning and boosting, and Personalization for affinity-based ranking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that business attributes like popularity, recency or margin can be used as custom-ranking criteria, detail on how custom ranking combines with textual ranking, and independent hands-on corroboration of custom ranking in practice.
